info.title: Bidora pilot open registration
info.description: Approved password self-registration boundary. It records required display-only first and last names, creates only an unverified identity and grants no membership or tenant authority.

post.summary: Request creation of an unverified password identity
post.description: Requires an exact approved HTTPS Origin without pre-session CSRF. Existing identities receive the same 202 response. Malformed and existing identities consume privacy-scoped Redis limits. No tenant membership, capability or context is created.

first_name.description: Display spelling preserved exactly; leading/trailing whitespace and control characters are rejected.

last_name.description: Display spelling preserved exactly; leading/trailing whitespace and control characters are rejected.

202.description: Generic accepted response for newly created and existing identities. No body.

Failure.description: Safe generic failure without identity, password, token or dependency details.
